title: Capstone in Chicanx and Latinx Studies
description: This course is a culmination of the upper-division core courses in CLS. Students will apply the knowledge acquired from CLX core courses, cultivate team building and leadership skills, and produce a community-engaged research project. Students will be required to develop a final project that could consist of a written essay, art project, and/or performance. The course will conclude with a student-led showcase that will include the class and community partners in celebration of their collective efforts. Prerequisites: CLX 102 or department approval.
